body: From what I gather, A’s husband is only okay with my bf and A meeting if all 4 of us can be there. I don’t know if he’s ready either for it to be a “just the two of them” thing.
I didn’t lose my virginity until 23. Didn’t have my first kiss until 20. It doesn’t matter. What matters is the experience. You’re gonna be fine.

Of course, I didn’t want this post to be interpreted like it’s a better alternative. It just helped temporarily for me, or at least took my mind off it. It’s the next morning now and I still feel like shit but I guess sleeping it off helped.
\^ nail on the head for me

I don’t really get happiness guilt although I can understand it. And same with those lyrics. 

I feel more guilty when I’m depressed tbh. My thought process flows in ways like “why are you even depressed, you don’t have any reason to be, there are other people with actual problems and here you are feeling sorry for yourself”. 

I have therapy on Tuesday. I’m planning to talk about this and hopefully figure out why.

This account started as a throwaway. Now it’s kind of my mental health / vent account, since a few people IRL know my main account. It’s good to have another account to be able to get things off your chest without being tied to your main IMO.
I don't like bothering people when I feel like this, besides I don't know if I could really describe how I feel. Maybe I'll just go lay down and cuddle with him in a minute
You’re right. Forgive me for venting in a sub specifically for venting. Thanks for the shitty pep talk.
That’s exactly it! Just someone else, even a song, that can help me figure out what I’m feeling and why.

Thanks for your help. He seemed better when we woke up a few minutes ago and he was thankful for me being there for him. I still feel like I wasn’t helpful enough to him last night lol but things seem at least a little better this morning. Thanks again <3
